backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the StudentSathi backend, defining data types and shared functions for feature requests, user profiles, announcements, assignments, study tasks, and conversation history, with role-based access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping implemented feature IDs and titles to their affected source files, related components, and test IDs, covering Leave Application form layout changes and other UI features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Auto-generated JSON document providing short natural-language summaries of each frontend source file, used as a reference for build planning and documentation.
frontend/.release/production-version.txt: Single-value file containing the current production draft version number (73) used by the CI/CD system to determine which build to promote to the live channel.
frontend/.release/README.md: Documents the CI/CD production version management system, explaining how updating production-version.txt promotes a specific draft version to the live channel without rebuilding source code.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the full design token system (colors, borders, charts, sidebar) in both light and dark modes.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app, loading html2pdf.js from CDN and mounting the React root div with the main TSX module.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with all application routes, wraps the app in ThemeProvider for light/dark mode, and renders the global Toaster notification component.
frontend/src/components/AssignmentChatbo: Floating chatbot component for the Assignment Format page supporting multi-language UI, voice input/output, image upload via Tesseract OCR, and AI-assisted assignment content generation with download options.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main app layout component with a sticky header containing desktop and mobile navigation links, a main content outlet, and a footer with attribution.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Butto: Reusable Button primitive with support for multiple variants, sizes, and an asChild prop that clones styles onto a child element.
Primitive Card component with sub-components (CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription, CardContent, CardFooter) for consistent card-based UI layouts.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Sheet: Primitive slide-in Sheet/drawer component with context-based open state, supporting left/right/top/bottom sides, a trigger, and an overlay backdrop.
frontend/src/components/primitives/Toast: Placeholder Toaster component that renders nothing, intended as a stub for a future toast notification implementation.
frontend/src/components/StudentSathiAssi: AI chat assistant component supporting text, voice, and image (OCR via Tesseract.js) input, with assignment generation/confirmation flow and conversation saving via React Query hooks.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Dai: Documentation note indicating that DailyProgressChart.tsx is working correctly and must not be modified as part of the weekly chart fix.
Displays a donut SVG chart and stats grid summarizing daily study task completion, pending counts, and total study time.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Pro: Wrapper section that conditionally renders either the DailyProgressChart or WeeklyProgressChart based on the current viewType prop.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Sub: Small badge component that displays a subject name with a color class derived from subject name or an optional color override.
A searchable popover dropdown component for filtering study planner tasks by subject, displaying each subject with its task count and supporting single-selection with a checkmark indicator.
frontend/src/components/studyPlanner/Wee: A card component that renders a donut SVG chart and stats grid showing weekly study task progress, including completed/pending counts and total study time for completed tasks.
frontend/src/components/UserGuidelineDoc: Empty file with no content or exports.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous ICP backend actor using React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, and persisting identity across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query mutations and queries for backend interactions including feature requests, assignment generation, conversation saving, and study planner task CRUD operations.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerSort.t: A hook that persists and restores the study planner sort mode ('default' or 'dateTime') in localStorage across sessions.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerSubjec: A hook that independently persists and restores subject filter selections for the daily and weekly study planner views using localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useStudyPlannerView.t: A hook that persists and restores the study planner view mode ('daily' or 'weekly') in localStorage, defaulting to 'weekly'.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (backgrounds, foregrounds, primary, sidebar, charts, etc.).
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that mounts the root component wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
Page for creating and formatting academic assignments, supporting multi-language UI, title page fields, font/spacing settings, an editor, AI improvement, and PDF/Word/text download.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Landing page displaying a hero section and a grid of navigation cards linking to the app's main tools (assignment format, study planner, notes cleaner, leave application, resume builder, feature request).
Page for generating formatted leave application letters in multiple languages, with fields for student details, recipient type, leave reason, and date range, plus copy and PDF download actions.
frontend/src/pages/NotesCleanerPage.tsx: Page that takes rough notes as input and converts them into clean, formatted text with options for bullet points, definition style, and auto-detected headings, with copy and TXT download support.
frontend/src/pages/RequestFeaturePage.ts: Page with a form allowing students to submit feature requests (with optional email) via a mutation hook, providing feedback via toast notifications.
frontend/src/pages/ResumeBuilderPage.tsx: A React page that lets students and freshers build a simple text-based resume by filling in personal info, education, skills, and projects, then generating and copying the formatted output.
frontend/src/pages/StudyPlannerPage.tsx: A full-featured study planner page supporting authenticated (ICP backend) and guest modes, with task creation, completion toggling, deletion, sorting, subject filtering, view switching (daily/weekly), and PDF/TXT export.
frontend/src/utils/leaveApplicationDateF: Provides utility functions to format Date objects into human-readable strings and date ranges (with day count) for use in leave application letters.
frontend/src/utils/leaveApplicationLette: Defines types and a multilingual letter template generator for leave applications, supporting 20 languages and multiple recipient types (principal, teacher, HOD, manager, HR) with localized strings.
frontend/src/utils/leaveApplicationPdfEx: Handles PDF export of leave application letters using html2pdf, with per-language label mappings and RTL language support.
frontend/src/utils/leaveApplicationReaso: Defines a set of predefined leave reason options (sick, family, personal, emergency, other) with associated sentence templates and a helper to retrieve the appropriate reason sentence.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerBulletSty: Configures and exposes the bullet style (currently locked to dash) used by the Notes Cleaner feature, with a helper to get the bullet prefix string.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerFormat.ts: Implements text formatting logic for the Notes Cleaner tool, including auto-detecting headings, applying definition-style formatting, and splitting text into sentences per line.
frontend/src/utils/notesCleanerTxtDownlo: Provides a `downloadNotesAsTxt` function that generates a filename (from a custom name or the first word of the content plus date) and triggers a browser download of cleaned notes as a plain text file.
Exports `parseDurationToMinutes` and `formatMinutesToDuration` to convert between duration strings (e.g., '1.5 hours', '30 minutes') and numeric minute values.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerGuestStor: Manages guest-mode Study Planner tasks in localStorage, exposing CRUD functions (load, add, toggle completion, delete, clear) and a `GuestStudyTask` interface.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerPdfExport: Exports `exportTasksToPdf` which generates a formatted HTML document from Study Planner tasks and opens it in a new window to trigger the browser's print-to-PDF dialog.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerSort.ts: Provides deterministic sorting for Study Planner tasks with two modes: default (by task ID) and dateTime (chronological by date/time, tasks without dates last).
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerTaskDateT: Utility functions for converting HTML date/time inputs to backend-compatible types and formatting task date/time values for display, handling both bigint (backend) and number (guest) representations.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerTxtExport: Exports `exportTasksToTxt` which formats Study Planner tasks into a plain-text document with a header, summary counts, and task details, then triggers a browser file download.
frontend/src/utils/studyPlannerWeek.ts: Provides date utilities for the weekly Study Planner view, including normalizing bigint/number task dates, computing the current week's Monday–Sunday bounds, and checking/indexing dates within the current week.
frontend/src/utils/subjectColorMapping.t: Provides a centralized mapping of academic subjects to color names, with utility functions to retrieve Tailwind CSS badge and indicator bar color classes for a given subject.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routes, with sessionStorage persistence helpers and a function to remove sensitive params from the URL hash.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with OKLCH-based design tokens, custom border radii, accordion keyframes, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Tracks the current project state (version 3) for a Leave Application Generator tool, documenting five targeted fixes including form layout changes, a Clear button, and a PDF download freeze fix.
unknown.txt: Describes the feature set and UI behavior specifications for a student assignment editor page and an embedded 'Student Sathi Assistant' chatbot, including formatting tools, download options, and chat interaction rules.
